description: FREE: hands Ania a reference image you generated or the user sent, then runs the check (the small prep fee is only charged at creation and is already in quote_avatar with ownImageRef). With imageUrl (public https link): register + check. Without: returns a single-use PUT upload link (5 min); after uploading, call again with ownImageRef. If it fails, the reason and fix come back: regenerate and resend. Recipe: full body or knees-up, centred, facing the camera, flat single-colour background (green #00FF00, no gradient), no text or watermark, 1024×1024 or larger, consistent style. A real person’s face: real_person=true and consent=true only if the user says it is them or they have permission.
